cheapest_falsification: A single v9/v10 pair with a tool-output/token mismatch, failed strict parsing, non-exact prefix, cache fallback, or no amortized prefill reduction falsifies the mechanism; the frozen campaign runs two pairs for repeatability.
claim_boundary: This is a model-coupled inference/controller performance and exact-output microbenchmark on synthetic fixture data. It is not a real code repair, external task success, coding-capability estimate, training result, held-out evaluation, RL result, or long-horizon completion result.

decision_rule.GO_for_v10_performance_use: All four attempts complete; both paired raw-output/token-ID comparisons are exact; all v10 stages reuse the exact prefix without fallback; v10 amortized prefill tokens are at least 20% lower in both paired repeats; paired median total wall time is not more than 10% slower; no resource abort.
decision_rule.NO_GO: Any correctness mismatch, incomplete strict tool interaction, cache fallback, resource abort, or failure to meet the prefill reduction rule. No rerun under this protocol.

design.independent_grader: not applicable; no repair claim; strict parser plus actual lease-bound source read and finish interaction only
design.pairing: same synthetic messages and fixture; same deterministic per-replicate lease; one model load and one process; ABBA order

sampling.seed: not applicable to greedy decode; fixed order and same weights

falsifiable_hypothesis: Across two paired repeats, v10 will complete the same strict read_lines then finish interaction as v9 with byte-identical raw actions and generated token IDs, exact shared-prefix reuse at every stage, at least 20% fewer amortized prefill tokens including one shared-prefix build per turn, and median total wall time no more than 10% slower.

comparison_metrics: exact raw action outputs and generated token IDs
strict parsed read_lines and finish actions
amortized prefill tokens including one shared-prefix build per turn
measured prefill time, cache build/restore time, attempt wall time
guard_launch_checks: clean tracked worktree at exact commit
all controller source hashes for v9 and v10
implementation.tokenizer_preflight_result: All six choice/argument prompts tested have the exact v10 shared-prefix token prefix; maximum prompt length 3191/8192.

primary_outcome: Pairwise equality of raw model outputs and generated token IDs plus successful strict read_lines parsing, real fixture read, and strict finish parsing in all four attempts.
research_question: For identical deterministic Qwen2.5-Coder-7B tool interactions, does v10 shared-prefix KV reuse preserve strict tool outputs while lowering prompt prefill work compared with v9?
secondary_outcomes: Amortized prefill tokens (sum of MLX prefill input tokens plus one cached shared prefix per turn)
Measured prompt-prefill seconds including shared-prefix cache construction
Peak process-tree RSS, MLX active/peak memory, host available memory, swap growth, disk free
stopping_rule: Execute exactly four attempts in the frozen ABBA order. Stop immediately at any declared resource limit or runtime/correctness failure. Do not rerun or replace a failed attempt under this protocol.

task_and_exposure.prior_exposure: Model has prior synthetic VARE controller/tool exposure. This new synthetic fixture does not establish pretraining non-exposure. No candidate source task or held-out task is used.
task_and_exposure.task_type: synthetic tool-interaction fixture; not an external repository repair task
